plugin.call.input: {pluginId:string, operationId:string, parameters:object}. Only system-registered plugins enabled for this app.
plugin.call.output: JSON response from the plugin operation. Provider credentials stay on the server.

finance.calculate.output: Verified built-in result for the selected financial protocol

finance.portfolio.input: {holdings:[{symbol,units,cost,price}],cash:number}. Cost and price are CNY per unit; units is the quantity held.

storage.read.output: JSON value or null. The initial key 'inputs' contains default protocol inputs.

storage.write.output: {saved:true}. Active verified releases only; failed builds cannot write.

ai.explain.output: String explanation of server-calculated saved inputs. Model configuration required.
